position: Additional Areas for Reform (National Intelligence Council)
proposal: The Mandate recommends that an incoming administration require non-CIA officers to make up at least 50 percent of the National Intelligence Council's membership, and that the NIC's first-among-equals chairman be an outsider drawn from one of the three major IC agencies other than CIA, reporting to the Principal Deputy DNI. The aim is greater analytic independence and a wider range of agency perspectives.
remaining: A requirement that at least half the NIC come from outside CIA.
An outside NIC chair reporting to the Principal Deputy DNI.
